log_text: BOP-STACK-01 showed FLT-0610 with accumulator pressure low. Recharged the accumulator bottles to restore function. The fix is temporary and a follow-up check is still needed next shift. Logged by Patel.

30 January 2025, worked on DRAWWORKS-01, fault code FLT-0802 showed up, turns out the brake pads were worn beyond limit, so brake pad change carried out, but the fix is temporary and a follow-up check is still needed next shift AS

TOP-DRIVE-01 was serviced on January 7, 2025, due to high vibration on the main bearing as indicated by fault code FLT-39A. The main bearing was swapped out to resolve the issue. The unit is back in service and running normally. PR

On 17/01/2025, the top drive displayed fault code FLT-0521 due to gearbox oil running over temperature. A gearbox oil change was carried out to address the issue. After the maintenance, the top drive was tested and found to be functioning correctly, returning to service. Logged by Lars Eriksen.

29 January 2025, I worked on DRAWWORKS-01 and found that the drive chain was running dry. I greased the drive chain to address the issue. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. Logged by T. Hallworth.

MUD-PUMP-01 was serviced on 9 January 2025 for fault code FLT-0392, which indicated a piston seal leaking at the fluid end. A seal swap carried out resolved the issue, and the unit is back in service and running normally. LE

Worked on MUD-PUMP-01 this shift, fault code FLT-0392 showed up on the panel indicating a piston seal leak at the fluid end. Changed out the piston seal as per the issue, got the unit running again but still waiting on parts to finish the job. LE
BOP-STACK-01 25 January 2025 routine function check after rig move pressure tested the stack job not closed yet to be re-checked after 12 hours running JO

January 13, 2025, maintenance was performed on DRAWWORKS-01. The drive chain was observed running dry, so I greased the drive chain to address the issue. However, the condition is beyond what can be done on site and has been escalated to onshore engineering. Logged by Raman.

On 31/02/2025, I worked on MUD-PUMP-04 which was displaying fault code FLT-0392. The issue was a leaking piston seal at the fluid end, so I replaced the seal. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. Logged by Tom Hallworth.

On 14/01/2025, I worked on DRAWWORKS-01 where the drive chain was running dry. The chain was lubricated to resolve the issue, and the unit is back in service and running normally. Logged by Maria Kowalczyk.
